newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 26,000 T white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 26,000 T white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs (GEZA) has issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes ofraws, a GEZA spokesman said on Thursday.
March 26 was set as the final date to receive price offers and the two amounts should be shipped between April 15 and May 15.
Results of the tender would be made on March 27, the official said.
